text: 10 OVERDOSAGE There is no known antidote for Paclitaxel Protein-Bound Particles for Injectable Suspension (albumin-bound) overdosage. The primary anticipated complications of overdosage would consist of bone marrow suppression, sensory neurotoxicity, and mucositis.
